# CC-CEDICT 数据声明

CC-CEDICT is a community maintained Chinese-English dictionary, published by MDBG, continuing CEDICT by Paul Andrew Denisowski (1997, 1998).

- Source: https://www.mdbg.net/chinese/dictionary?page=cc-cedict
- Download: https://www.mdbg.net/chinese/export/cedict/cedict_1_0_ts_utf-8_mdbg.txt.gz
- Snapshot published: 2026-10-03T08:59:08Z; downloaded 2026-10-04; 125,173 source entries.

- Compressed source SHA-256: `c01e6d2d7f7545b4a29e08da17e7ec77a1b1fd1531009269e74e42f391fb2c1d`.
- The distributed GZip source is unmodified, with original headers and notices preserved. It is also embedded as `DesktopPet.CC-CEDICT.gz` in DesktopPet. At runtime the app filters short glosses and builds a transient bidirectional search index; it does not distribute a modified dictionary or claim comprehensive machine translation. Supplemental application/search aliases are independent lookup hints in program code.

The dictionary data retains its CC BY-SA 4.0 license independently of the program's MIT license. No endorsement by MDBG or CC-CEDICT contributors is implied. No additional restrictions are applied to the dictionary data; recipients may extract, share and adapt the supplied original source under its license.
